name: io.github.brunopompeo1/base-defi-shield-x402
title: Base & EVM DeFi Pre-Trade Shield (x402)
description: Pre-trade token safety: honeypot, taxes, liquidity and oracle divergence on Base/EVM via x402.

tools.name: base_token_safety_check
tools.description: Screens one ERC-20 token on Base or another EVM chain right before a swap and returns a verdict SAFE, CAUTION, DANGER or HONEYPOT, a safety score from 0 to 100 and a swap-eligibility decision with a recommended maximum slippage. It combines the GoPlus contract scan and a honeypot.is sell simulation (buy and sell tax, hidden owner, blacklist, mintable, proxy, cannot-sell-all), live DexScreener liquidity, volume and pool age, and a DefiLlama oracle price compared with the DEX price, and lists every finding as a coded flag. Use it as the last guard of a trading or treasury agent before buying an unfamiliar token, or to explain why a token is risky. Do not use it as investment advice or a price forecast, for NFTs or native coins, or for a wallet address, which belongs to evm_wallet_risk_check. Live data: results change as markets move, so call it again right before each trade rather than reusing an old result. Read 'verdict', 'swapEligibility' and 'flags'. Costs 0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with ok false and 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Read-only: it never signs, sends or approves a transaction and holds no keys.

address.description: Token contract address as 0x followed by 40 hex characters, or on Base one of the tickers WETH, ETH, USDC, USDBC, CBBTC, AERO, VIRTUAL, DEGEN, BRETT, TOSHI, ONDO or CLANKER. Anything else returns ok false with error 'invalid_token_address'.

chain.description: Chain the token lives on. Default base. Aliases such as eth, arb, op, matic, bnb, avax or a numeric chain id are also accepted; an unknown value falls back to base.

tools.name: evm_wallet_risk_check
tools.description: Screens one EVM address before an agent pays it, approves it or accepts funds from it: GoPlus address-security flags for phishing, theft, sanctions, money laundering, mixers, fake KYC, blacklists and malicious contracts created, rolled up into a risk verdict CLEAN, SUSPICIOUS or MALICIOUS with a score, plus live on-chain facts from an RPC node: whether it is a person's wallet (EOA) or a contract, its transaction count and its ETH and USDC balances on Base. Use it as a counterparty check in payment, payout and escrow flows, or to vet the deployer of a token found by base_token_safety_check. Do not use it to identify who owns a wallet, which it cannot do, or for a token contract's own risk, which base_token_safety_check covers. CLEAN only means no known flag, not a guarantee. Read 'riskVerdict', 'triggeredFlags' and 'accountType'. Costs 0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or with a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header instead of an exception, and every failure is a JSON body with ok false and 'error', so an agent loop never breaks on a thrown error. Read-only: it never signs, sends or approves a transaction and holds no keys.

address.description: Wallet or contract address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters. ENS names and tickers are not accepted and return ok false with error 'invalid_wallet_address'.

chain.description: Chain to screen the address on. Default base.
